 ‘Werwulf’ Gets Hard ‘R’ Rating for Disturbing Violence, Gore, Sexual Assault & Graphic Nudity
 John Squires 
 November 11, 2026 
 Share 
 Facebook 
 X 
 Reddit 
 Bluesky 
 Threads 
 WhatsApp 
 Copy link 
 Robert Eggers has been calling the upcoming Werwulf his darkest movie to date, and that’s reflected in the official rating that the MPA has just turned in for Eggers’ new nightmare.
 Focus Features’ Werwulf is rated an extremely hard ‘R’ for “ strong bloody/disturbing violent content, gore, sexual assault, graphic nudity and strong sexual content .”
 The film will be playing in 35mm in select theaters on Christmas Day.
 Check out a handy graphic below that lists off all the locations that will be playing Werwulf in 35mm on December 25 , and get your tickets NOW to see the film in 35mm on Christmas!
 Set in 13th century England,  Werwulf sees a mysterious creature stalk the land as local folklore becomes a terrifying reality. The film hits theaters everywhere December 25 via Focus Features.
 Here’s the logline: “Witness Robert Eggers’ most visceral and haunting experience yet. Focus Features presents  Werwulf , a harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.
 Aaron Taylor-Johnson  ( Nosferatu ),  Lily-Rose Depp  ( Nosferatu ),  Willem Dafoe  ( The Lighthouse ),  Ralph Ineson  ( The Witch ), and  Bodhi Rae Breathnach  ( Hamnet ) star.
